There would appear to be some element of doubt about the times recorded by Robin Brown and Doug.

Bill Weller and then Jim Rimmer pulled back five teams but newcomer Robin Brown was also not at his best and we were back to 23rd again. Robin is one of our most exciting prospects but perhaps a short lap would have been more suitable on this occasion.
In the A team Jamie Stevenson ran a stalwart first leg and Robin Brown confirmed Gordon Biscoe's predictions by running an immaculate 10th stage.
Robin Brown and Lionel Mann came into the side and there were much improved runs from Captain Colin Pears[illegible] and Simon Holmes. Finishing with 10 in 23 our league lead stretched to 133 points.
